title: Zero-network contribution-aligned executor-backed real-task protocol freeze
objective: Freeze a paired real-task protocol that isolates typed prior scope, sparse-probe representativeness, and candidate-retaining triage without provider calls.

prior_conditions.copied-global: Incorrect comparator that copies one learned global/domain state into every domain-specific state.
prior_conditions.global-only: Initialize only the shared global state; every domain-specific state starts cold and receives no copied domain state.
prior_conditions.contextual: Initialize shared state globally and preserve an independent explicitly labeled state for each task domain.
prior_conditions.identity_invariant: No condition may silently alias global-only and contextual state or infer domain state from held-out outputs.

pairing_and_fairness.counterfactual_branch_accounting: Charge candidate and fallback evaluation in every gate branch; never charge only the selected branch.

probe_protocol.spent_evidence_policy: Development probes may tune no held-out threshold after execution; held-out outputs can never be relabeled as development evidence.

candidate_retaining_triage.accept: Deploy the candidate and retain its immutable provenance.
candidate_retaining_triage.reject: Do not deploy; route to the frozen fallback and retain the candidate unchanged for later review.
candidate_retaining_triage.abstain: Evidence is insufficient or conflicting; suspend deployment, route to the frozen fallback, and retain the candidate unchanged.

destructive_gate.discard: Do not deploy and irreversibly remove the candidate from future review.

decision_gate.protocol_pass: All source identities, split disjointness, executor restrictions, condition fairness, probe definitions, gate actions, candidate-retention invariants, and zero-call restrictions validate.
decision_gate.future_method_support: On a separately authorized run, contextual plus candidate-retaining triage must reduce harmful deployment versus copied-global and destructive gating while preserving non-trivial helpful deployment and improving or matching reward per cumulative token.
decision_gate.representativeness_support: Representative probes must have better sign agreement or lower false-safe/false-harm error than deliberately shifted probes on the frozen downstream streams.
decision_gate.direction_change_trigger: If prior identity has no paired real-task effect, representative probes do not outperform shifted probes, or triage has no safety/usefulness advantage over identity-correct reset, narrow or change the ACL main contribution before scaling.
